194005962.title: File:Catalog page featuring the artwork “Una mujer plástica con una cabeza para cada día de la semana” by Honys Torres (2011).jpg

ImageDescription.value: Catalog page from the I PDVSA Oriente Art Biennial (2011) featuring the artwork “Una mujer plástica con una cabeza para cada día de la semana” by Honys Torres. The mixed‑media piece, created with acrylic paint and recycled materials, reflects on identity, mass media influence, and the construction of the contemporary female image through symbolic “heads” representing different roles or personas assumed throughout the week. This catalog page is part of the surviving documentation of the exhibition.

193970990.title: File:Poster – II PDVSA Oriente Art Biennial (2013), Cumaná.jpg

ImageDescription.value: Official poster of the II PDVSA Oriente Art Biennial, held at the Museum of Contemporary Art of Cumaná, Venezuela, on 16 November 2013. The design features multicolored vertical typography on a black background, along with the PDVSA institutional logo. This piece was part of the event’s promotional material.

193970991.title: File:Poster – I PDVSA Oriente Art Biennial (2011), Cumaná.jpg

ImageDescription.value: Official poster of the regional art biennial organized by PDVSA Oriente to promote artistic production in eastern Venezuela. The 2011 edition was held at the Mateo Manaure Museum (Maturín, Monagas). This poster corresponds to the institutional promotional material of the biennial and features folded geometric shapes in neutral tones, colorful typography, and the PDVSA logo.
